scope: Gate 3: persistent conversation continuity, Connect-carried two-party voice, SIP/PSTN/WebRTC, basic files and availability.

acceptance.title: Durable VoIP 3 conversation model
acceptance.proof: One persistent cid spans messages, bounded sessions and replacement connections. Session end cannot close it. Explicit developer create produces a separate conversation. Upgrade preserves existing history/receipts; all six nouns have one documented owner.

acceptance.title: Authenticated session lifecycle
acceptance.proof: Public native APIs invite/accept/reject/cancel/end and expose negotiated readiness. Forged binding, expired authority and incompatible profiles fail before effects; retries preserve logical mutation identity.

acceptance.title: Connect-carried native duplex voice
acceptance.proof: Native client ↔ UCTP/QUIC ↔ Connect ↔ Vapi duplex WebSocket supports audible two-way interaction and interruption. Local impairments meet selected thresholds; live proof identifies both legs.

acceptance.title: SIP endpoint interoperability
acceptance.proof: A named local SIP endpoint exchanges two-way audio through Connect in both directions; browser/native interoperability and advertised lifecycle controls pass.

acceptance.title: Connect-carried telephone voice
acceptance.proof: Inbound and outbound Telnyx SIP/PSTN audio traverse the local Connect bridge to Vapi WebSocket. Explicit route binding, human or independently attributed telephone audio confirmation under decision 008 and paired teardown are recorded; direct Telnyx/Vapi audio is not substituted.

acceptance.title: Browser WebRTC experience
acceptance.proof: Public browser SDK and test client establish actual two-way WebRTC audio with native/SIP peers and Vapi on the named topology; permission/ICE failures and teardown are handled.

acceptance.title: Authorized reliable artifacts
acceptance.proof: Native reliable transfer and HTTP retrieve matching bytes for an authorized participant; integrity, quota, interrupted transfer, current authority, expiry/deletion and consistent backup/restore pass.

acceptance.title: Artifact and control interface parity
acceptance.proof: Rust, Python, TypeScript native clients and HTTP/JSON share the same session/file/availability authority and errors. HTTP is control/file access, not a QUIC audio transport.

acceptance.title: Basic availability and optional preference
acceptance.proof: Fresh available/unavailable observations become unknown when stale; only authorized subjects update/discover them. Expiring preferred route does not auto-contact a fallback; identity remains durable.

acceptance.title: Useful context across channel changes
acceptance.proof: Draft/fact in chat → voice uses it → spoken decision recorded → session ends → Connect restarts → messaging uses the decision. Repeat each required voice route; retain one cid, source provenance and observed context-delivery outcome.

acceptance.title: Isolation and failure recovery
acceptance.proof: Second-conversation contrast, ambiguous caller, revoked access, duplicated/out-of-order outcome, hard kill, disk-full and uncertain provider creation preserve isolation and durable intent; no false live-session resurrection or duplicate effects.

acceptance.title: Public SDK and honest capability boundaries
acceptance.proof: Native Rust/Python/Node can control sessions and send/receive audio on their declared native bindings. Browser WebRTC is separate and usable through a public facade. Examples use public APIs; unsupported video/profile/media modes fail explicitly.

acceptance.title: Reproducible local candidate and review
acceptance.proof: Bounded offline runner plus separate real-provider qualification, installed-candidate checks and schema/database/blob restore all pass at recorded revisions. Owner can review evidence and limits; SMS stays deferred and no remote deployment occurs.

closure_rule: All required criteria have recorded local and named live behavior evidence for the qualified implementation and installed candidate. Offline runners never operate provider accounts. Separate live automation is explicitly authorized and uses decision 008; failed supplemental trials remain recorded. SMS is deferred separately and remains required for full v0.1.

deferred.sms: G2-018/G2-019 resume after approval; repeat SMS context boundary before full v0.1
deferred.assistant_and_tools: Gate 4: additional assistant selection, MCP/skill and task resumption
deferred.video: Gate 5 delivery; minimal profile selection belongs to G3-006/G3-008

limits: Local macOS arm64 and recorded topology only; not full v0.1.
Each configured local audio channel caps queued media at 200 ms; total media latency includes multiple stages and provider/model/network delay.

Newest-context item budget 32 KiB with explicit omissions; original authorized history retained. Current four-route decisions and draft facts recalled after restart; earlier ASR/model ambiguity remains preserved.
